notes.title: Small update on leaderboard
notes.content:
The following have been updated


 A score of 100% on the leaderboard will be displayed as a tie for first place
  If you are tied for first place, you will be displayed at the top of the leaderboard
 Fixed an issue where some Unicode characters were not displayed on the leaderboard.

notes.title: Major Update : Steam Workshop, Custom Map Editor
notes.content:
Create and share your own map

Here we're posting a major update.
We hope you enjoy this.


Steam Workshop

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37997805/863a361337777df4d75879d13e91265bacdf3036.png

Browse the workshop to find User Custom Maps.
When you subscribe to the map, it will be automatically downloaded and imported into the game.


Custom Map Editor

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37997805/fc8c3839f3eb46890a8fc9ce2d42918cb64f2cf6.png

Create your own map and share it with everyone.

You can switch to editor by clicking the top left button in the game lobby.

You can download a sample project here : 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/17qITkfOq6lw8TCHuvYlX1iWed4zm5X1o/view?usp=share_link

(Download as a ZIP file and import into editor)

notes.title: Steam Leaderboards Update
notes.content:
Steam Leaderboards 

When you clear a song, your score will be uploaded to the Steam Leaderboard.
You can check the ranking in the song information window.
You must clear the song at least once after the update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37997805/7bd53a2ec4477596faf713573a2ceb1f80d868de.png

And the items below have been updated

 Song Lock/Unlock feature is removed, Now all songs are playable.

notes.title: Several Minor Updates
notes.content:
Listed items below have been updated

 Dsp buffer size optimized
 Vertical bar movement improved
 HP is reduced in practice mode (But not fail)
 Long note judgment range slightly increased (+5px)
 Can skip in play result screen
 Fixed some playback time bugs in resume and retry
 Lobby UI changed
 Score rank system added
 Full combo clear data will be saved and displayed


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37997805/fe1c58f8ab097e2ecc0483084caf4d0bf14128a2.png

notes.title: Synchronization has improved
notes.content:
Synchronization has improved by changing the method of measuring the playback time of song.
     Updating in every frame -> Directly accessing the dsp time.
 Removed legacy auto sync function in preference settings.

notes.title: Practice Mode
notes.content:
Practice Mode is Now Available

Practice Mode

 HP is not reduced
 Miss performance does not play even in Miss or Fail
 Clear stats do not change

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content: Chopin's Norturne Op.9 No.2 and Prelude in E Minor has been added.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed a problem that Vertical Sensitivity was not applied.

Rondo Alla Turca's difficulty has been lowered.

notes.title: Major Bug Fixes
notes.content: Fixed a bug that could not load songs in some language of windows OS.
